**Title:** REPAIR & DISENCHANT

**Special UI Elements:**
*   **Rename text field:** Present (the long rectangular box in the top-middle).
*   **Cost text:** Not visible (no experience level cost is displayed).
*   **Stacked slots:** Yes (the input slot on the left appears to show stacked item borders).
*   **Power-selection buttons:** Not present.
*   **Check/X buttons:** Not present (the interface uses the standard anvil layout without modern confirmation buttons).
